evidence.name: Screen field: Outline color
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Outline color" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Outline color
sections.description: Sets the color of the bar's outline (defaults to black; appears only when the outline thickness is above 0 and the bar is shown). Pick a color that frames the bar without competing with the button — a subtle, theme-matched tone usually works best, keeping attention on the CTA itself.
